s1.syndrome_frame: Abdominal pain with weight loss and gastrointestinal symptoms
key_facts: Medical history of chronic kidney disease
Pain associated with nausea, vomiting, and acid reflux
Echogenic liver parenchyma with fatty infiltration on ultrasound
Positive Doppler flow within the subcapsular hepatic lesion

raw.syndrome_frame: Abdominal pain with weight loss and gastrointestinal symptoms
key_facts: Medical history of chronic kidney disease
Pain associated with nausea, vomiting, and acid reflux
Echogenic liver parenchyma with fatty infiltration on ultrasound
Positive Doppler flow within the subcapsular hepatic lesion

differentials: Hepatic metastasis from other primary sites
per_call: Hepatic metastasis from other primary sites

shortlist.label: Metastatic melanoma to the liver
shortlist.why_kept: Positive immunostaining for melanoma markers and presence of a subcapsular enhancing lesion

shortlist.label: Hepatocellular carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated liver enzymes and presence of a hypoechoic lesion on ultrasound

shortlist.label: Pancreatic adenocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Epigastric pain and elevated lipase level

shortlist.label: Cholangiocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated alkaline phosphatase level and presence of a subcapsular lesion

raw.rationale: The patient's liver biopsy showed islands of neoplastic cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm and immunostaining results were positive for human melanoma black-45, smooth muscle actin, and melanoma antigen recognized by T cells 1 (melan-A), which are characteristic of melanoma.

rejected.label: Hepatocellular carcinoma
rejected.why: Immunostaining results were negative for hepatocyte paraffin 1 and glypican-3, which are typically positive in hepatocellular carcinoma.

rejected.label: Pancreatic adenocarcinoma
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging studies do not specifically suggest pancreatic involvement, and the liver biopsy results do not support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Cholangiocarcinoma
rejected.why: The patient's imaging studies and biopsy results do not suggest bile duct involvement or cholangiocarcinoma.

rejected.label: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms, imaging studies, and biopsy results do not support this diagnosis, and immunostaining results were not consistent with gastrointestinal stromal tumor.
